full_name: Angela Ards | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2010–2011 Humanities William Bentinck-Smith Fellow Southern Methodist University
bio: Angela Ards is an assistant professor of English at Southern Methodist University, where she specializes in African American literature and culture, 20th-century American literature, critical gender studies, and autobiography.
